firm_data.firm_description: Romer Debbas, LLP is a full-service real estate law firm representing domestic and international clients ranging from individuals to prominent institutions. The firm focuses on both commercial and residential real estate, real estate finance, entity and trust formation, and real estate related litigation.
notable_facts: Romer Debbas is consistently ranked by The Real Deal as one of New York City’s top real estate law firms based on volume.
The firm is also ranked by U.S. News & World Report as one of the top real estate law firms in the country.

Several of the firm's attorneys have been named in Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, U.S. News & World Report, Crain’s Notable Leaders in Real Estate, Crain’s Notable Leaders in Law, AV Rated by Martindale Hubbleand Leaders in the Law.

email.subject: AI for Romer Debbas - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Michael,

The Real Deal consistently ranks Romer Debbas as one of NYC's top real estate law firms based on volume. That kind of throughput in commercial real estate finance and transactions creates a specific challenge: scaling precision without sacrificing the client relationships that built your reputation.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to show how ex-lawyers like us are helping similar firms stay competitive in high-volume real estate work.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
